visuals.caption_fil: May pagsusuri at pagkumpirma sa pagitan ng pakikinig at pagkilos.
visuals.caption_en: Assessment and confirmation connect listening with action.
visuals.alt_text_fil: Apat na magkakasunod na kahon: makinig at magtanong, suriin ang pinagmulan, itala at ilahad, kumpirmahin ang susunod.
visuals.alt_text_en: Four linked boxes: listen and ask, assess the source, record and present, confirm the next step.
